candidate_construction: Equal-arclength midpoint seeds and their reflections about the section centreline, ordered by intrados arclength.
target_sampling: Equal-arclength midpoints starting at the crown symmetry axis, on both the contact and intrados. The grids are reflection-closed with equal weights.
installation_basis: Prescribed synthetic installation scenario, fixed before response evaluation and selection. The 0.30 m clearance is an assumed mounting allowance; no site-specific mounting dimensions or surveyed sight lines are supplied.
visibility_basis: Visibility is assumed throughout each accessible interval in this synthetic scenario. Supplied obstruction intervals can be entered as visibility exclusions; their endpoints are excluded too.

asymmetric.basis: One crown reflector is displaced from the symmetric layout.
